name: Walking Log Drum
desc: FUSES the amapiano log drum (bass.amapiano.log_drum - penv knock, sawtooth body) with a jazz walking bass's ii-V root motion (bass.jazz.walking_251): the log drum stops looping one chord and starts WALKING. D minor, log-drum pocket at cps ~.5.

code.full: note("<[d2 ~ ~ d3 ~ d2 ~ f2] [e2 ~ ~ e3 ~ e2 ~ g2] [a2 ~ ~ a2 ~ g2 ~ e2] [d2 ~ ~ f2 ~ a2 ~ c3]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").penv(${glide}).pdec(.09).attack(.002).decay(.5).sustain(.3).release(.22).lpf(sine.range(900,1600).slow(16)).lpq(3).shape(.4).gain(${gain}).room(.1).every(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: note("<[d2 ~ d2 d3 ~ d2 f2 a2] [e2 ~ e2 e3 ~ g2 bb2 g2] [a2 ~ a2 a3 ~ g2 f2 e2] [d2 f2 a2 c3 ~ a2 f2 d2]>").add(note(${root})).s("sawtooth").penv(${glide}*1.2).pdec(.08).attack(.002).decay(.45).sustain(.3).release(.18).lpf(sine.range(1100,2000).slow(8)).lpq(3).shape(.45).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.75,${gain}).fast(4)).room(.08).every(4, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(3).play()
